items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: I was with Happy Cook and Little Chink Martin, Charlie DuPont, Harry Shields.

ctx.x: Oh. That was such an incredibly well-known band. And y'all played a few jobs in different places, that's for sure.
Oh, my Lord. We played in the Palmer House of Chicago. We were in the first band. Oh, that... Look at Doc... Look at Doc Sushon and Johnny Wiggs and... Mm-hmm. Harry Shields.

items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
